output.summary: An annual squash native to the Americas, though its exact domestication center is unclear. Its fig-like leaves and oval, watermelon-like fruits stand out; the fruit, seeds, flowers, leaves and tender shoots are eaten, with immature fruit cooked as summer squash.
output.edibilityNote: Immature fruit is cooked as summer squash; mature fruit becomes sweets, drinks or pasta-like strands, while seeds, flowers, leaves and tender shoots are also eaten.
